llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对Ti-6Al-4V的后处理工艺（高速超声振动强化铣削）对表面完整性及强化机理进行研究，完全符合用户所需的后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: paper does not explicitly report fatigue life or porosity closure; focus is on surface integrity and strengthening mechanism rather than direct fatigue or tensile performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索高速超声振动强化铣削对Ti-6Al-4V表面完整性和强化机制的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用高速超声振动强化铣削工艺处理Ti-6Al-4V试样。
summary_zh.result: 工艺显著改善表面粗糙度、残余压应力分布及显微硬度，提升表面完整性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面粗糙度测量、残余应力测试及硬度实验验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of high-speed ultrasonic vibration-strengthening milling on surface integrity and strengthening mechanism of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: High-speed ultrasonic vibration-strengthening milling was applied to Ti-6Al-4V specimens as a post-processing treatment.
summary_en.result: The treatment significantly improved surface roughness, compressive residual stress distribution, and microhardness, enhancing surface integrity.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through surface roughness measurements, residual stress tests, and hardness experiments.
